article.story: BOSTON -- — Brandon Benjamin scored 19 points and grabbed 13 rebounds off of the bench to lead Boston College over Harvard 74-69 on Wednesday. Zak Smrekar added 13 points, ive assists and three blocks for the Eagles (5-0). Armoni Zeigler finished with 12 points and seven assists. Jason Singleton led the Crimson (2-4) with 20 points. Robert Hinton added 18 points and two steals for Harvard. Tey Barbour finished with 14 points. Boston College went into halftime ahead of Harvard 30-22. Smrekar scored 10 points in the first half. Benjamin scored 15 points in the second half. Up next Boston College next plays Sunday against NJIT at home, and Harvard will visit Holy Cross on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
